claim: A pre-release version has lower precedence than the associated normal version under SemVer 2.0.0.
sub_question: What is the precedence of a pre-release vs the normal version?
evidence: Clause 9 and 11.3 state pre-release versions rank below the associated normal version.
quote_or_anchor: Pre-release versions have a lower precedence than the associated normal version. When major, minor, and patch are equal, a pre-release version has lower precedence than a normal version: Example: 1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0.
notes: Canonical SemVer 2.0.0 specification text at semver.org.

claim: Build metadata is ignored for version precedence; versions differing only in build metadata have equal precedence.
sub_question: How does build metadata affect precedence?
evidence: Clause 10 requires build metadata to be ignored when determining precedence.
quote_or_anchor: Build metadata MUST be ignored when determining version precedence. Thus two versions that differ only in the build metadata, have the same precedence.
notes: So X.Y.Z+build has the same precedence as X.Y.Z.

claim: Build metadata does not figure into precedence calculations; only major, minor, patch, and pre-release do.
evidence: Clause 11.1 lists the fields used for precedence and explicitly excludes build metadata.
quote_or_anchor: Precedence MUST be calculated by separating the version into major, minor, patch and pre-release identifiers in that order (Build metadata does not figure into precedence).
notes: Confirms build-only variants are treated as normal versions for ordering.

claim: A version with a pre-release identifier has lower precedence than the same core version with build metadata only.
sub_question: What is the precedence order between pre-release and build-metadata-only for the same core version?
evidence: Combining clauses 9 and 11.3 (pre-release lower than normal) with clauses 10 and 11.1 (build ignored so build-only equals normal) yields pre-release lower than build-metadata-only for the same X.Y.Z. Example: 1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0+20130313144700.
quote_or_anchor: Pre-release versions have a lower precedence than the associated normal version. Build metadata MUST be ignored when determining version precedence. When major, minor, and patch are equal, a pre-release version has lower precedence than a normal version: Example: 1.0.0-alpha < 1.0.0.
notes: Derived only from normative SemVer 2.0.0 clauses 9, 10, and 11; not contradicted in the spec.
